edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: The word of YHWH that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אֶל־מִיכָה הַמֹּרַשְׁתִּי בִּימֵי יוֹתָם אָחָז יְחִזְקִיָּה מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה אֲשֶׁר־חָזָה עַל־שֹׁמְרוֹן וִירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Hear, all you peoples! Attend, earth and all that fills it! Let the Lord YHWH be a witness against you, the Lord from His holy temple.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם הַקְשִׁיבִי אֶרֶץ וּמְלֹאָהּ וִיהִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה בָּכֶם לְעֵד אֲדֹנָי מֵהֵיכַל קָדְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: For look, YHWH is coming out of His place; He will descend and tread upon the heights of the earth.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה יְהוָה יֹצֵא מִמְּקוֹמוֹ וְיָרַד וְדָרַךְ עַל־במותי [בָּמֳתֵי] אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The mountains will melt beneath Him and the valleys split open, like wax before fire, like water poured down a slope.
verses.hebrew: וְנָמַסּוּ הֶהָרִים תַּחְתָּיו וְהָעֲמָקִים יִתְבַּקָּעוּ כַּדּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי הָאֵשׁ כְּמַיִם מֻגָּרִים בְּמוֹרָד׃

verses.english: All this is because of Jacob's rebellion and the sins of Israel's house. What is Jacob's rebellion? Is it not Samaria? And what are Judah's high places? Are they not Jerusalem?
verses.hebrew: בְּפֶשַׁע יַעֲקֹב כָּל־זֹאת וּבְחַטֹּאות בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל מִי־פֶשַׁע יַעֲקֹב הֲלוֹא שֹׁמְרוֹן וּמִי בָּמוֹת יְהוּדָה הֲלוֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: I will make Samaria a heap in the field, a place for planting a vineyard. I will pour her stones into the valley and uncover her foundations.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי שֹׁמְרוֹן לְעִי הַשָּׂדֶה לְמַטָּעֵי כָרֶם וְהִגַּרְתִּי לַגַּי אֲבָנֶיהָ וִיסֹדֶיהָ אֲגַלֶּה׃

verses.english: All her carved images will be smashed, all her prostitution wages burned in fire, and all her idols I will lay waste. For she gathered them from a prostitute's wages, and to a prostitute's wages they will return.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־פְּסִילֶיהָ יֻכַּתּוּ וְכָל־אֶתְנַנֶּיהָ יִשָּׂרְפוּ בָאֵשׁ וְכָל־עֲצַבֶּיהָ אָשִׂים שְׁמָמָה כִּי מֵאֶתְנַן זוֹנָה קִבָּצָה וְעַד־אֶתְנַן זוֹנָה יָשׁוּבוּ׃

verses.english: Because of this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked. I will make a lament like jackals and mourning like ostriches.
verses.hebrew: עַל־זֹאת אֶסְפְּדָה וְאֵילִילָה אֵילְכָה שילל [שׁוֹלָל] וְעָרוֹם אֶעֱשֶׂה מִסְפֵּד כַּתַּנִּים וְאֵבֶל כִּבְנוֹת יַעֲנָה׃

verses.english: For her wounds are incurable; it has come to Judah, reached the gate of My people, as far as Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אֲנוּשָׁה מַכּוֹתֶיהָ כִּי־בָאָה עַד־יְהוּדָה נָגַע עַד־שַׁעַר עַמִּי עַד־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Do not tell it in Gath; do not weep at all. In Beth-leaphrah I have rolled myself in dust.
verses.hebrew: בְּגַת אַל־תַּגִּידוּ בָּכוֹ אַל־תִּבְכּוּ בְּבֵית לְעַפְרָה עָפָר התפלשתי [הִתְפַּלָּשִׁי׃]

verses.english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in naked shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan has not come out. Beth-ezel's mourning will take its support away from you.
verses.hebrew: עִבְרִי לָכֶם יוֹשֶׁבֶת שָׁפִיר עֶרְיָה־בֹשֶׁת לֹא יָצְאָה יוֹשֶׁבֶת צַאֲנָן מִסְפַּד בֵּית הָאֵצֶל יִקַּח מִכֶּם עֶמְדָּתוֹ׃

verses.english: For the inhabitant of Maroth writhed in longing for good, because disaster came down from YHWH to Jerusalem's gate.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־חָלָה לְטוֹב יוֹשֶׁבֶת מָרוֹת כִּי־יָרַד רָע מֵאֵת יְהוָה לְשַׁעַר יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish! She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion, for Israel's rebellions were found in you.
verses.hebrew: רְתֹם הַמֶּרְכָּבָה לָרֶכֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁבֶת לָכִישׁ רֵאשִׁית חַטָּאת הִיא לְבַת־צִיּוֹן כִּי־בָךְ נִמְצְאוּ פִּשְׁעֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib will prove deceptive to Israel's kings.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן תִּתְּנִי שִׁלּוּחִים עַל מוֹרֶשֶׁת גַּת בָּתֵּי אַכְזִיב לְאַכְזָב לְמַלְכֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Again I will bring a possessor to you, inhabitant of Mareshah; Israel's glory will come as far as Adullam.
verses.hebrew: עֹד הַיֹּרֵשׁ אָבִי לָךְ יוֹשֶׁבֶת מָרֵשָׁה עַד־עֲדֻּלָּם יָבוֹא כְּבוֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Make yourself bald and shear your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the eagle, for they have gone into exile from you.
verses.hebrew: קָרְחִי וָגֹזִּי עַל־בְּנֵי תַּעֲנוּגָיִךְ הַרְחִבִי קָרְחָתֵךְ כַּנֶּשֶׁר כִּי גָלוּ מִמֵּךְ׃

verses.english: Woe to those who plan iniquity and work evil on their beds! At morning light they do it, because it is in the power of their hands.
verses.hebrew: הוֹי חֹשְׁבֵי־אָוֶן וּפֹעֲלֵי רָע עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם בְּאוֹר הַבֹּקֶר יַעֲשׂוּהָ כִּי יֶשׁ־לְאֵל יָדָם׃

verses.english: They covet fields and seize them, houses and take them; they oppress a man and his house, a person and his inheritance.
verses.hebrew: וְחָמְדוּ שָׂדוֹת וְגָזָלוּ וּבָתִּים וְנָשָׂאוּ וְעָשְׁקוּ גֶּבֶר וּבֵיתוֹ וְאִישׁ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ׃

verses.english: Therefore thus says YHWH: “Look, I am planning disaster against this family, from which you will not remove your necks. You will not walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה הִנְנִי חֹשֵׁב עַל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הַזֹּאת רָעָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־תָמִישׁוּ מִשָּׁם צַוְּארֹתֵיכֶם וְלֹא תֵלְכוּ רוֹמָה כִּי עֵת רָעָה הִיא׃

verses.english: On that day someone will take up a taunt against you and lament a mournful lament: ‘We are utterly ruined! He changes the portion of My people. How He takes it away from me! To a turncoat He divides our fields.’
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִשָּׂא עֲלֵיכֶם מָשָׁל וְנָהָה נְהִי נִהְיָה אָמַר שָׁדוֹד נְשַׁדֻּנוּ חֵלֶק עַמִּי יָמִיר אֵיךְ יָמִישׁ לִי לְשׁוֹבֵב שָׂדֵינוּ יְחַלֵּק׃

verses.english: Therefore you will have no one to cast a measuring cord by lot in the assembly of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן לֹא־יִהְיֶה לְךָ מַשְׁלִיךְ חֶבֶל בְּגוֹרָל בִּקְהַל יְהוָה׃

verses.english: ‘Do not prophesy!’ they prophesy. They will not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not retreat.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּטִּפוּ יַטִּיפוּן לֹא־יַטִּפוּ לָאֵלֶּה לֹא יִסַּג כְּלִמּוֹת׃

verses.english: Is it said, house of Jacob, ‘Has the Spirit of YHWH grown impatient? Are these His deeds?’ Do not My words do good to the one who walks uprightly?
verses.hebrew: הֶאָמוּר בֵּית־יַעֲקֹב הֲקָצַר רוּחַ יְהוָה אִם־אֵלֶּה מַעֲלָלָיו הֲלוֹא דְבָרַי יֵיטִיבוּ עִם הַיָּשָׁר הוֹלֵךְ׃

verses.english: But of late My people have risen as an enemy. You strip the mantle from the garment of those passing by securely, returning from war.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶתְמוּל עַמִּי לְאוֹיֵב יְקוֹמֵם מִמּוּל שַׂלְמָה אֶדֶר תַּפְשִׁטוּן מֵעֹבְרִים בֶּטַח שׁוּבֵי מִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: You drive the women of My people from the house of their delight; from their children you take My splendor forever.
verses.hebrew: נְשֵׁי עַמִּי תְּגָרְשׁוּן מִבֵּית תַּעֲנֻגֶיהָ מֵעַל עֹלָלֶיהָ תִּקְחוּ הֲדָרִי לְעוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Rise and go, for this is no resting place; because of uncleanness it destroys, with grievous destruction.
verses.hebrew: קוּמוּ וּלְכוּ כִּי לֹא־זֹאת הַמְּנוּחָה בַּעֲבוּר טָמְאָה תְּחַבֵּל וְחֶבֶל נִמְרָץ׃

verses.english: If a man walking in wind and falsehood lies, ‘I will prophesy to you of wine and strong drink,’ he would be this people's prophet!
verses.hebrew: לוּ־אִישׁ הֹלֵךְ רוּחַ וָשֶׁקֶר כִּזֵּב אַטִּף לְךָ לַיַּיִן וְלַשֵּׁכָר וְהָיָה מַטִּיף הָעָם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely assemble Israel's remnant. I will put them together like Bozrah's sheep, like a flock within its pasture; they will be noisy with people.
verses.hebrew: אָסֹף אֶאֱסֹף יַעֲקֹב כֻּלָּךְ קַבֵּץ אֲקַבֵּץ שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל יַחַד אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ כְּצֹאן בָּצְרָה כְּעֵדֶר בְּתוֹךְ הַדָּבְרוֹ תְּהִימֶנָה מֵאָדָם׃

verses.english: The breaker has gone up before them; they have broken through, passed the gate and gone out through it. Their king has passed before them, with YHWH at their head.”
verses.hebrew: עָלָה הַפֹּרֵץ לִפְנֵיהֶם פָּרְצוּ וַיַּעֲבֹרוּ שַׁעַר וַיֵּצְאוּ בוֹ וַיַּעֲבֹר מַלְכָּם לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיהוָה בְּרֹאשָׁם׃

verses.english: I said: “Hear now, heads of Jacob and rulers of Israel's house! Is it not for you to know justice,
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר שִׁמְעוּ־נָא רָאשֵׁי יַעֲקֹב וּקְצִינֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הֲלוֹא לָכֶם לָדַעַת אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: you who hate good and love evil, who tear their skin from them and their flesh from their bones,
verses.hebrew: שֹׂנְאֵי טוֹב וְאֹהֲבֵי רעה [רָע] גֹּזְלֵי עוֹרָם מֵעֲלֵיהֶם וּשְׁאֵרָם מֵעַל עַצְמוֹתָם׃

verses.english: who eat the flesh of My people, strip their skin from them, break their bones and divide them up as in a pot, like meat within a cauldron?
verses.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר אָכְלוּ שְׁאֵר עַמִּי וְעוֹרָם מֵעֲלֵיהֶם הִפְשִׁיטוּ וְאֶת־עַצְמֹתֵיהֶם פִּצֵּחוּ וּפָרְשׂוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּסִּיר וּכְבָשָׂר בְּתוֹךְ קַלָּחַת׃

verses.english: Then they will cry to YHWH, but He will not answer them. He will hide His face from them at that time, because they have made their deeds evil.”
verses.hebrew: אָז יִזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה וְלֹא יַעֲנֶה אוֹתָם וְיַסְתֵּר פָּנָיו מֵהֶם בָּעֵת הַהִיא כַּאֲשֶׁר הֵרֵעוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH concerning the prophets who lead My people astray, who bite with their teeth and proclaim peace, but consecrate war against anyone who puts nothing into their mouths:
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה עַל־הַנְּבִיאִים הַמַּתְעִים אֶת־עַמִּי הַנֹּשְׁכִים בְּשִׁנֵּיהֶם וְקָרְאוּ שָׁלוֹם וַאֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִתֵּן עַל־פִּיהֶם וְקִדְּשׁוּ עָלָיו מִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: “Therefore you will have night without vision and darkness without divination. The sun will set upon the prophets, and the day will grow dark over them.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן לַיְלָה לָכֶם מֵחָזוֹן וְחָשְׁכָה לָכֶם מִקְּסֹם וּבָאָה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִים וְקָדַר עֲלֵיהֶם הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced; all of them will cover their upper lips, for there is no answer from God.”
verses.hebrew: וּבֹשׁוּ הַחֹזִים וְחָפְרוּ הַקֹּסְמִים וְעָטוּ עַל־שָׂפָם כֻּלָּם כִּי אֵין מַעֲנֵה אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of YHWH, with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his rebellion and to Israel his sin.
verses.hebrew: וְאוּלָם אָנֹכִי מָלֵאתִי כֹחַ אֶת־רוּחַ יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּט וּגְבוּרָה לְהַגִּיד לְיַעֲקֹב פִּשְׁעוֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל חַטָּאתוֹ׃

verses.english: Hear this now, heads of Jacob's house and rulers of Israel's house, who abhor justice and twist everything straight,
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־נָא זֹאת רָאשֵׁי בֵּית יַעֲקֹב וּקְצִינֵי בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל הַמֲתַעֲבִים מִשְׁפָּט וְאֵת כָּל־הַיְשָׁרָה יְעַקֵּשׁוּ׃

verses.english: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with injustice!
verses.hebrew: בֹּנֶה צִיּוֹן בְּדָמִים וִירוּשָׁלִַם בְּעַוְלָה׃

verses.english: Her heads judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price and her prophets divine for silver; yet they lean on YHWH, saying, “Is not YHWH in our midst? No disaster will come upon us.”
verses.hebrew: רָאשֶׁיהָ בְּשֹׁחַד יִשְׁפֹּטוּ וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ בִּמְחִיר יוֹרוּ וּנְבִיאֶיהָ בְּכֶסֶף יִקְסֹמוּ וְעַל־יְהוָה יִשָּׁעֵנוּ לֵאמֹר הֲלוֹא יְהוָה בְּקִרְבֵּנוּ לֹא־תָבוֹא עָלֵינוּ רָעָה׃

verses.english: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed as a field, Jerusalem will become heaps of ruins, and the mountain of the house will become wooded heights.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן בִּגְלַלְכֶם צִיּוֹן שָׂדֶה תֵחָרֵשׁ וִירוּשָׁלִַם עִיִּין תִּהְיֶה וְהַר הַבַּיִת לְבָמוֹת יָעַר׃

verses.english: In the latter days the mountain of YHWH's house will be established at the head of the mountains and raised above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים יִהְיֶה הַר בֵּית־יְהוָה נָכוֹן בְּרֹאשׁ הֶהָרִים וְנִשָּׂא הוּא מִגְּבָעוֹת וְנָהֲרוּ עָלָיו עַמִּים׃

verses.english: Many nations will go and say, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of YHWH and to the house of Jacob's God. He will teach us some of His ways, and we will walk in His paths.” For instruction will go out from Zion, and the word of YHWH from Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וְהָלְכוּ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְאָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַעֲלֶה אֶל־הַר־יְהוָה וְאֶל־בֵּית אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹרֵנוּ מִדְּרָכָיו וְנֵלְכָה בְּאֹרְחֹתָיו כִּי מִצִּיּוֹן תֵּצֵא תוֹרָה וּדְבַר־יְהוָה מִירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: He will judge between many peoples and arbitrate for strong nations far away. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift sword against nation, nor will they learn war anymore.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁפַט בֵּין עַמִּים רַבִּים וְהוֹכִיחַ לְגוֹיִם עֲצֻמִים עַד־רָחוֹק וְכִתְּתוּ חַרְבֹתֵיהֶם לְאִתִּים וַחֲנִיתֹתֵיהֶם לְמַזְמֵרוֹת לֹא־יִשְׂאוּ גּוֹי אֶל־גּוֹי חֶרֶב וְלֹא־יִלְמְדוּן עוֹד מִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: They will sit, each beneath his vine and beneath his fig tree, with no one making them afraid, for the mouth of YHWH of hosts has spoken.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשְׁבוּ אִישׁ תַּחַת גַּפְנוֹ וְתַחַת תְּאֵנָתוֹ וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד כִּי־פִי יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת דִּבֵּר׃

verses.english: For all the peoples walk, each in the name of his god, but we will walk in the name of YHWH our God forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: כִּי כָּל־הָעַמִּים יֵלְכוּ אִישׁ בְּשֵׁם אֱלֹהָיו וַאֲנַחְנוּ נֵלֵךְ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: “On that day,” declares YHWH, “I will gather the limping one and assemble the banished one and those I have afflicted.
verses.hebrew: בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא נְאֻם־יְהוָה אֹסְפָה הַצֹּלֵעָה וְהַנִּדָּחָה אֲקַבֵּצָה וַאֲשֶׁר הֲרֵעֹתִי׃

verses.english: I will make the limping one a remnant and the one cast far away a strong nation. YHWH will reign over them on Mount Zion from now and forever.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת־הַצֹּלֵעָה לִשְׁאֵרִית וְהַנַּהֲלָאָה לְגוֹי עָצוּם וּמָלַךְ יְהוָה עֲלֵיהֶם בְּהַר צִיּוֹן מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: And you, tower of the flock, hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come: the former dominion will arrive, the kingdom for the daughter of Jerusalem.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה מִגְדַּל־עֵדֶר עֹפֶל בַּת־צִיּוֹן עָדֶיךָ תֵּאתֶה וּבָאָה הַמֶּמְשָׁלָה הָרִאשֹׁנָה מַמְלֶכֶת לְבַת־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Now why do you cry aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that anguish has seized you like a woman giving birth?
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה לָמָּה תָרִיעִי רֵעַ הֲמֶלֶךְ אֵין־בָּךְ אִם־יוֹעֲצֵךְ אָבָד כִּי־הֶחֱזִיקֵךְ חִיל כַּיּוֹלֵדָה׃

verses.english: Writhe and burst forth, daughter of Zion, like a woman giving birth! For now you will go out from the city, dwell in the field and come as far as Babylon. There you will be rescued; there YHWH will redeem you from your enemies' hand.
verses.hebrew: חוּלִי וָגֹחִי בַּת־צִיּוֹן כַּיּוֹלֵדָה כִּי־עַתָּה תֵצְאִי מִקִּרְיָה וְשָׁכַנְתְּ בַּשָּׂדֶה וּבָאת עַד־בָּבֶל שָׁם תִּנָּצֵלִי שָׁם יִגְאָלֵךְ יְהוָה מִכַּף אֹיְבָיִךְ׃

verses.english: Now many nations have gathered against you, saying, “Let her be defiled, and let our eyes gaze upon Zion!”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַיִךְ גּוֹיִם רַבִּים הָאֹמְרִים תֶּחֱנָף וְתַחַז בְּצִיּוֹן עֵינֵינוּ׃

verses.english: But they do not know YHWH's thoughts or understand His counsel, for He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה לֹא יָדְעוּ מַחְשְׁבוֹת יְהוָה וְלֹא הֵבִינוּ עֲצָתוֹ כִּי קִבְּצָם כֶּעָמִיר גֹּרְנָה׃

verses.english: Rise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron and your hoofs bronze. You will crush many peoples, and I will devote their gain to YHWH and their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
verses.hebrew: קוּמִי וָדוֹשִׁי בַת־צִיּוֹן כִּי־קַרְנֵךְ אָשִׂים בַּרְזֶל וּפַרְסֹתַיִךְ אָשִׂים נְחוּשָׁה וַהֲדִקּוֹת עַמִּים רַבִּים וְהַחֲרַמְתִּי לַיהוָה בִּצְעָם וְחֵילָם לַאֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Now muster yourself in troops, daughter of troops! He has laid siege against us; with a rod they strike Israel's judge on the cheek.
verses.hebrew: עַתָּה תִּתְגֹּדְדִי בַת־גְּדוּד מָצוֹר שָׂם עָלֵינוּ בַּשֵּׁבֶט יַכּוּ עַל־הַלְּחִי אֵת שֹׁפֵט יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, small to be among Judah's clans—from you one will come out for Me to be ruler in Israel, whose goings out are from of old, from ancient days.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֵּית־לֶחֶם אֶפְרָתָה צָעִיר לִהְיוֹת בְּאַלְפֵי יְהוּדָה מִמְּךָ לִי יֵצֵא לִהְיוֹת מוֹשֵׁל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וּמוֹצָאֹתָיו מִקֶּדֶם מִימֵי עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: Therefore he will give them up until the time when she who gives birth has borne; then the rest of his brothers will return to the sons of Israel.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן יִתְּנֵם עַד־עֵת יוֹלֵדָה יָלָדָה וְיֶתֶר אֶחָיו יְשׁוּבוּן עַל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: He will stand and shepherd in YHWH's strength, in the majesty of the name of YHWH his God. They will dwell, for now he will be great to the ends of the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְעָמַד וְרָעָה בְּעֹז יְהוָה בִּגְאוֹן שֵׁם יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו וְיָשָׁבוּ כִּי־עַתָּה יִגְדַּל עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: This one will be peace. When Assyria comes into our land and treads in our citadels, we will raise against him seven shepherds and eight princes of men.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה זֶה שָׁלוֹם אַשּׁוּר כִּי־יָבוֹא בְאַרְצֵנוּ וְכִי יִדְרֹךְ בְּאַרְמְנֹתֵינוּ וַהֲקֵמֹנוּ עָלָיו שִׁבְעָה רֹעִים וּשְׁמֹנָה נְסִיכֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: They will shepherd Assyria's land with the sword and Nimrod's land at its entrances. He will rescue from Assyria when it comes into our land and treads within our border.
verses.hebrew: וְרָעוּ אֶת־אֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר בַּחֶרֶב וְאֶת־אֶרֶץ נִמְרֹד בִּפְתָחֶיהָ וְהִצִּיל מֵאַשּׁוּר כִּי־יָבוֹא בְאַרְצֵנוּ וְכִי יִדְרֹךְ בִּגְבוּלֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Jacob's remnant will be among many peoples like dew from YHWH, like showers upon grass, which do not wait for a man or hope in the sons of humankind.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה שְׁאֵרִית יַעֲקֹב בְּקֶרֶב עַמִּים רַבִּים כְּטַל מֵאֵת יְהוָה כִּרְבִיבִים עֲלֵי־עֵשֶׂב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְקַוֶּה לְאִישׁ וְלֹא יְיַחֵל לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃

verses.english: Jacob's remnant will be among the nations, amid many peoples, like a lion among forest beasts, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which passes through, tramples and tears, with no one to rescue.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה שְׁאֵרִית יַעֲקֹב בַּגּוֹיִם בְּקֶרֶב עַמִּים רַבִּים כְּאַרְיֵה בְּבַהֲמוֹת יַעַר כִּכְפִיר בְּעֶדְרֵי צֹאן אֲשֶׁר אִם עָבַר וְרָמַס וְטָרַף וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: Your hand will be raised above your adversaries, and all your enemies will be cut off.
verses.hebrew: תָּרֹם יָדְךָ עַל־צָרֶיךָ וְכָל־אֹיְבֶיךָ יִכָּרֵתוּ׃

verses.english: “On that day,” declares YHWH, “I will cut off your horses from your midst and destroy your chariots.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא נְאֻם־יְהוָה וְהִכְרַתִּי סוּסֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּי מַרְכְּבֹתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will cut off the cities of your land and tear down all your fortifications.
verses.hebrew: וְהִכְרַתִּי עָרֵי אַרְצֶךָ וְהָרַסְתִּי כָּל־מִבְצָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will cut off sorceries from your hand, and you will have no soothsayers.
verses.hebrew: וְהִכְרַתִּי כְשָׁפִים מִיָּדֶךָ וּמְעוֹנְנִים לֹא יִהְיוּ־לָךְ׃

verses.english: I will cut off your carved images and standing stones from your midst, and you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.
verses.hebrew: וְהִכְרַתִּי פְסִילֶיךָ וּמַצֵּבוֹתֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְלֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה עוֹד לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will uproot your Asherahs from your midst and destroy your cities.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַשְׁתִּי אֲשֵׁירֶיךָ מִקִּרְבֶּךָ וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּי עָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed.”
verses.hebrew: וְעָשִׂיתִי בְּאַף וּבְחֵמָה נָקָם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא שָׁמֵעוּ׃

verses.english: Hear now what YHWH says: “Rise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.”
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־נָא אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֹמֵר קוּם רִיב אֶת־הֶהָרִים וְתִשְׁמַעְנָה הַגְּבָעוֹת קוֹלֶךָ׃

verses.english: Hear, mountains, YHWH's case, and you enduring foundations of the earth! For YHWH has a case against His people, and He will contend with Israel.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ הָרִים אֶת־רִיב יְהוָה וְהָאֵתָנִים מֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ כִּי רִיב לַיהוָה עִם־עַמּוֹ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל יִתְוַכָּח׃

verses.english: “My people, what have I done to you? How have I wearied you? Answer Me!
verses.hebrew: עַמִּי מֶה־עָשִׂיתִי לְךָ וּמָה הֶלְאֵתִיךָ עֲנֵה בִּי׃

verses.english: For I brought you up from Egypt's land and redeemed you from the house of slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron and Miriam before you.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הֶעֱלִתִיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתִיךָ וָאֶשְׁלַח לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁה אַהֲרֹן וּמִרְיָם׃

verses.english: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab planned and what Balaam son of Beor answered him, from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may know YHWH's righteous acts.”
verses.hebrew: עַמִּי זְכָר־נָא מַה־יָּעַץ בָּלָק מֶלֶךְ מוֹאָב וּמֶה־עָנָה אֹתוֹ בִּלְעָם בֶּן־בְּעוֹר מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים עַד־הַגִּלְגָּל לְמַעַן דַּעַת צִדְקוֹת יְהוָה׃

verses.english: With what shall I come before YHWH and bow before God on high? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with year-old calves?
verses.hebrew: בַּמָּה אֲקַדֵּם יְהוָה אִכַּף לֵאלֹהֵי מָרוֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶנּוּ בְעוֹלוֹת בַּעֲגָלִים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה׃

verses.english: Will YHWH be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousands of streams of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my rebellion, the fruit of my body for the sin of my life?
verses.hebrew: הֲיִרְצֶה יְהוָה בְּאַלְפֵי אֵילִים בְּרִבְבוֹת נַחֲלֵי־שָׁמֶן הַאֶתֵּן בְּכוֹרִי פִּשְׁעִי פְּרִי בִטְנִי חַטַּאת נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: He has told you, human being, what is good. And what does YHWH require of you except to do justice, love steadfast kindness and walk humbly with your God?
verses.hebrew: הִגִּיד לְךָ אָדָם מַה־טּוֹב וּמָה־יְהוָה דּוֹרֵשׁ מִמְּךָ כִּי אִם־עֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפָּט וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד וְהַצְנֵעַ לֶכֶת עִם־אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH's voice calls to the city—and sound wisdom will see Your name: “Hear the rod and the One who appointed it!
verses.hebrew: קוֹל יְהוָה לָעִיר יִקְרָא וְתוּשִׁיָּה יִרְאֶה שְׁמֶךָ שִׁמְעוּ מַטֶּה וּמִי יְעָדָהּ׃

verses.english: Are there still in a wicked person's house treasures of wickedness and a detestable short ephah?
verses.hebrew: עוֹד הַאִשׁ בֵּית רָשָׁע אֹצְרוֹת רֶשַׁע וְאֵיפַת רָזוֹן זְעוּמָה׃

verses.english: Can I be pure with wicked scales and a bag of deceptive weights?
verses.hebrew: הַאֶזְכֶּה בְּמֹאזְנֵי רֶשַׁע וּבְכִיס אַבְנֵי מִרְמָה׃

verses.english: Her rich people are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouths.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׁירֶיהָ מָלְאוּ חָמָס וְיֹשְׁבֶיהָ דִּבְּרוּ־שָׁקֶר וּלְשׁוֹנָם רְמִיָּה בְּפִיהֶם׃

verses.english: So I too have made you sick with striking, laying you waste because of your sins.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם־אֲנִי הֶחֱלֵיתִי הַכּוֹתֶךָ הַשְׁמֵם עַל־חַטֹּאתֶךָ׃

verses.english: You will eat but not be satisfied, with emptiness within you. You will put things aside but not save them; what you do save I will give to the sword.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תֹאכַל וְלֹא תִשְׂבָּע וְיֶשְׁחֲךָ בְּקִרְבֶּךָ וְתַסֵּג וְלֹא תַפְלִיט וַאֲשֶׁר תְּפַלֵּט לַחֶרֶב אֶתֵּן׃

verses.english: You will sow but not reap, tread olives but not anoint yourself with oil, and tread new wine but not drink wine.
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תִזְרַע וְלֹא תִקְצוֹר אַתָּה תִדְרֹךְ־זַיִת וְלֹא־תָסוּךְ שֶׁמֶן וְתִירוֹשׁ וְלֹא תִשְׁתֶּה־יָּיִן׃

verses.english: The statutes of Omri are kept, and all the practices of Ahab's house; you walk in their counsels, so that I may make you a desolation and her inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of My people.”
verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּר חֻקּוֹת עָמְרִי וְכֹל מַעֲשֵׂה בֵית־אַחְאָב וַתֵּלְכוּ בְּמֹעֲצוֹתָם לְמַעַן תִּתִּי אֹתְךָ לְשַׁמָּה וְיֹשְׁבֶיהָ לִשְׁרֵקָה וְחֶרְפַּת עַמִּי תִּשָּׂאוּ׃

verses.english: Alas for me! I have become like the gatherings of summer fruit, like the gleanings of the vintage: no cluster to eat, no first-ripe fig that my life longs for.
verses.hebrew: אַלְלַי לִי כִּי הָיִיתִי כְּאָסְפֵּי־קַיִץ כְּעֹלְלֹת בָּצִיר אֵין־אֶשְׁכּוֹל לֶאֱכוֹל בִּכּוּרָה אִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: The faithful person has perished from the land; there is no upright person among humankind. They all lie in wait for bloodshed; each hunts his brother with a net.
verses.hebrew: אָבַד חָסִיד מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְיָשָׁר בָּאָדָם אָיִן כֻּלָּם לְדָמִים יֶאֱרֹבוּ אִישׁ אֶת־אָחִיהוּ יָצוּדוּ חֵרֶם׃

verses.english: Their hands are skilled at evil: the official demands, the judge acts for payment, and the great man speaks his own craving, and they weave it together.
verses.hebrew: עַל־הָרַע כַּפַּיִם לְהֵיטִיב הַשַּׂר שֹׁאֵל וְהַשֹּׁפֵט בַּשִׁלּוּם וְהַגָּדוֹל דֹּבֵר הַוַּת נַפְשׁוֹ הוּא וַיְעַבְּתוּהָ׃

verses.english: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, your visitation, has come; now will be their confusion.
verses.hebrew: טוֹבָם כְּחֵדֶק יָשָׁר מִמְּסוּכָה יוֹם מְצַפֶּיךָ פְּקֻדָּתְךָ בָאָה עַתָּה תִהְיֶה מְבוּכָתָם׃

verses.english: Do not trust a neighbor; do not rely on a close companion. Guard the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your embrace.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תַּאֲמִינוּ בְרֵעַ אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בְּאַלּוּף מִשֹּׁכֶבֶת חֵיקֶךָ שְׁמֹר פִּתְחֵי־פִיךָ׃

verses.english: For a son treats his father with contempt, a daughter rises against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man's enemies are the people of his own house.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־בֵן מְנַבֵּל אָב בַּת קָמָה בְאִמָּהּ כַּלָּה בַּחֲמֹתָהּ אֹיְבֵי אִישׁ אַנְשֵׁי בֵיתוֹ׃

verses.english: But I will watch for YHWH; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בַּיהוָה אֲצַפֶּה אוֹחִילָה לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי יִשְׁמָעֵנִי אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: Do not rejoice over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise; though I sit in darkness, YHWH is a light for me.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׂמְחִי אֹיַבְתִּי לִי כִּי נָפַלְתִּי קָמְתִּי כִּי־אֵשֵׁב בַּחֹשֶׁךְ יְהוָה אוֹר לִי׃

verses.english: I will bear YHWH's indignation, for I have sinned against Him, until He pleads my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me out into the light; I will see His righteousness.
verses.hebrew: זַעַף יְהוָה אֶשָּׂא כִּי חָטָאתִי לוֹ עַד אֲשֶׁר יָרִיב רִיבִי וְעָשָׂה מִשְׁפָּטִי יוֹצִיאֵנִי לָאוֹר אֶרְאֶה בְּצִדְקָתוֹ׃

verses.english: My enemy will see, and shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is YHWH your God?” My eyes will look upon her; now she will be trampled like mud in the streets.
verses.hebrew: וְתֵרֶא אֹיַבְתִּי וּתְכַסֶּהָ בוּשָׁה הָאֹמְרָה אֵלַי אַיּוֹ יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיִךְ עֵינַי תִּרְאֶינָּה בָּהּ עַתָּה תִּהְיֶה לְמִרְמָס כְּטִיט חוּצוֹת׃

verses.english: A day for building your walls! On that day the boundary will be far extended.
verses.hebrew: יוֹם לִבְנוֹת גְּדֵרָיִךְ יוֹם הַהוּא יִרְחַק־חֹק׃

verses.english: On that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, from Egypt as far as the River, from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.
verses.hebrew: יוֹם הוּא וְעָדֶיךָ יָבוֹא לְמִנִּי אַשּׁוּר וְעָרֵי מָצוֹר וּלְמִנִּי מָצוֹר וְעַד־נָהָר וְיָם מִיָּם וְהַר הָהָר׃

verses.english: The land will become a desolation because of its inhabitants, because of the fruit of their deeds.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיְתָה הָאָרֶץ לִשְׁמָמָה עַל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ מִפְּרִי מַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Shepherd Your people with Your staff, the flock of Your inheritance, dwelling alone in a forest amid Carmel. Let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in days of old.
verses.hebrew: רְעֵה עַמְּךָ בְשִׁבְטֶךָ צֹאן נַחֲלָתֶךָ שֹׁכְנִי לְבָדָד יַעַר בְּתוֹךְ כַּרְמֶל יִרְעוּ בָשָׁן וְגִלְעָד כִּימֵי עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: “As in the days when you came out from Egypt's land, I will show him wonders.”
verses.hebrew: כִּימֵי צֵאתְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם אַרְאֶנּוּ נִפְלָאוֹת׃

verses.english: Nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will put a hand over their mouth; their ears will become deaf.
verses.hebrew: יִרְאוּ גוֹיִם וְיֵבֹשׁוּ מִכֹּל גְּבוּרָתָם יָשִׂימוּ יָד עַל־פֶּה אָזְנֵיהֶם תֶּחֱרַשְׁנָה׃

verses.english: They will lick dust like a snake; like creatures crawling on the earth they will tremble out of their enclosures. They will come in dread to YHWH our God and fear You.
verses.hebrew: יְלַחֲכוּ עָפָר כַּנָּחָשׁ כְּזֹחֲלֵי אֶרֶץ יִרְגְּזוּ מִמִּסְגְּרֹתֵיהֶם אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יִפְחָדוּ וְיִרְאוּ מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: Who is a God like You, bearing away iniquity and passing over rebellion for the remnant of His inheritance? He does not hold His anger forever, because He delights in steadfast love.
verses.hebrew: מִי־אֵל כָּמוֹךָ נֹשֵׂא עָוֺן וְעֹבֵר עַל־פֶּשַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא־הֶחֱזִיק לָעַד אַפּוֹ כִּי־חָפֵץ חֶסֶד הוּא׃

verses.english: He will again have compassion on us; He will subdue our iniquities. You will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּב יְרַחֲמֵנוּ יִכְבֹּשׁ עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ וְתַשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְצֻלוֹת יָם כָּל־חַטֹּאותָם׃

verses.english: You will grant faithfulness to Jacob, steadfast love to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from days of old.
verses.hebrew: תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב חֶסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ מִימֵי קֶדֶם׃
